body.purpose: Default UI text, table cells, form labels.

label.purpose: Section headers, role badges, chips — uppercase, tracked.

mono.purpose: Numeric/data values where column alignment matters.

shadows.name: card-shadow
shadows.purpose: Resting cards — intentionally a no-op; grouping comes from fill color.

shadows.name: card-shadow-floating
shadows.purpose: Dropdowns, popovers, the sidebar user-menu card — genuinely floating surfaces.

shadows.name: shadow-border-md
shadows.purpose: Hairline ring + soft drop-shadow for elements needing a defined edge without looking shadow-decorated.

motion.name: sidebar-transition
motion.purpose: Sidebar width + main-content marginLeft, moved in lockstep.

motion.name: text-fade-transition
motion.purpose: Nav label / section header / user-menu text opacity, synced to the sidebar width animation.

motion.name: duration-standard
motion.purpose: Default hover/focus color and transform transitions.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary action button — the only place solid green fills a control.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #12B76A; color: #0B0B0B; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; border: none; transition: background-color 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #0FA05C; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #12B76A; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Destructive Button
components.css: .ds-btn-destructive { background: #ED4E4E; color: #FAFAFA; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; border: none; transition: background-color 0.2s; } .ds-btn-destructive:hover { background: #C91313; } .ds-btn-destructive:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ED4E4E; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Flat resting card — separates from canvas via fill, not shadow.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #171717; color: #FAFAFA; border-radius: 10px; padding: 16px; box-shadow: none; }

components.name: Sidebar Nav Item
components.description: Active nav link — filled background plus a 2px red identity-accent left bar.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: #d4d4d8; text-decoration: none; position: relative; transition: background-color 0.15s, color 0.15s; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: #18181b; color: #fff; } .ds-nav-item-active { background: #27272A; color: #fff; } .ds-nav-bar { position: absolute; left: -12px; top: 4px; bottom: 4px; width: 2px; border-radius: 0 4px 4px 0; background: #F13636; }

components.name: Collapsible Sidebar Rail
components.description: Signature component: hover-to-expand icon rail (80px to 240px) with text fading in lockstep, border-r crossing the TopBar's border-b at the shared corner.
components.css: .ds-sidebar-rail { width: 80px; height: 100%; background: #0B0B0B; border-right: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.10); transition: width 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-sidebar-rail:hover { width: 240px; } .ds-sidebar-logo { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; height: 56px; padding: 0 16px; color: #FAFAFA; font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px; overflow: hidden; } .ds-sidebar-label { opacity: 0; transition: opacity 0.2s ease-in-out; } .ds-sidebar-rail:hover .ds-sidebar-label { opacity: 1; }

narrative.overview: This is a near-black canvas built for someone reading numbers all day, not a first-touch marketing surface. Every screen exists to answer one question fast: what's driving ad and page performance, and what should a Marketing Manager, Sales Director, or Business Owner do next. Green (#12B76A) reads as gain, red (#ED4E4E) as loss or danger, exactly like a terminal's up/down semantics, with the flat #0B0B0B canvas and #171717 card layer doing all the depth work instead of shadows. This system explicitly rejects the generic SaaS/AI-slop dashboard playbook: no purple/indigo gradients, no default Tailwind blue as a primary, no hero-metric stat-card clichés, no side-stripe colored borders, no gradient text, no glassmorphism. It is a direct, hand-ported adaptation of Sure's (app.sure.am) production design system, not a fresh invention — consistency with that source wins over novelty.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-only canvas (#0B0B0B), no light mode exists or is planned.
Green (#12B76A) is the only positive/primary action color; red is reserved for destructive actions and one deliberate identity-accent use (avatars, active-nav indicator).
Flat by default: cards separate from the canvas via a lighter fill (#171717), not shadows or borders.
Single typeface (Geist + Geist Mono) throughout; no display/body pairing.
Hairline borders (rgba(255,255,255,0.10)) instead of visible strokes for structural separation.

rules.name: The Terminal Semantics Rule
rules.body: Green means gain/go/primary. Red means loss/destructive, with the one confined exception of sidebar identity chrome (avatars, active indicator). Never introduce a third color as a competing primary.

rules.name: The No-Blue-No-Purple Rule
rules.body: Tailwind's default blue-*/indigo-*/violet-* scale is never used as a primary or accent. Chart blue and violet exist only inside multi-series chart legends, never as UI chrome.

rules.name: The One Typeface Rule
rules.body: Geist for everything, including headings. Do not introduce a second sans-serif for hierarchy — use weight/size instead.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. A shadow only appears as a response to the surface floating above the page (dropdown, popover, modal, drawer) — never as ambient decoration on a resting card.

dos: Do use #12B76A green as the only primary/positive action color.
Do keep cards flat (box-shadow: none) at rest; reserve shadow for genuinely floating surfaces.
Do use hairline borders (rgba(255,255,255,0.10)) for structural separation instead of visible strokes.
Do give every interactive element explicit hover, focus-visible, and active states.
Do animate state changes (sidebar width, text opacity, dropdown open) together, not independently.
Do keep red confined to destructive actions plus the sidebar's identity chrome — its two roles, and no more.
donts: Don't use Tailwind's default blue-*/indigo-*/violet-* as a primary or accent color.
Don't use a colored border-left/border-right greater than 1px as a decorative accent stripe.
Don't use flat shadow-md as ambient decoration on a resting card.
Don't introduce a second sans-serif for hierarchy.
Don't ship generic SaaS/AI-slop patterns: hero-metric stat cards, identical repeated card grids, glassmorphism as decoration, tiny uppercase tracked eyebrows above every section.
